line_label: Movantik revenues (printed 'Movantik® revenues' in the NET REVENUES note)
revenue_scope: RedHill Biopharma's 'Movantik revenues' line of the NET REVENUES note in its interim and annual financial statements: net revenues from Movantik in the territory RedHill held, worldwide excluding Europe and Canada (and, until October 2020, excluding Israel). The table states no geography, and the gold series is the U.S. column of AstraZeneca's regional product-sales table, so the two lines do not share a scope.
geography: Not stated in the table. RedHill's rights: worldwide excluding Europe, Canada and Israel from April 2020, excluding Europe and Canada from October 2020; RedHill's 20-F states it focuses its commercial activities in the U.S.
why_separate: The gold series is AstraZeneca's U.S. column and ends at 2019Q3 when AstraZeneca stopped printing a Movantik row after sublicensing the product to RedHill. RedHill's line is a different issuer on a different, larger territory scope with an unreported gap (2019Q4-2020Q1), so it cannot be joined to the series. It carries the product past the end of its own series.
notes: Coverage 2020Q2-2022Q4, eleven quarters. Seven quarters are the current-quarter column of the quarter's own 6-K exhibit (2020Q2, 2020Q3, 2021Q1-Q3, 2022Q2, 2022Q3) and 2022Q1 is the restated current-quarter column of the 6-K/A. The three fourth quarters are derived as the Form 20-F full-year figure (2020 59,356; 2021 76,767; 2022 52,098, US$ thousands) less the nine-month figure printed in the third-quarter 6-K (39,347; 57,510; 41,462); RedHill prints no fourth-quarter Movantik line. 2022Q1 is the restated 9,329; the original 6-K (0001178913-22-002461, exhibit_2.htm) printed 14,614 before RedHill restated overstated net revenues (6-K/A 0001558370-22-016533). Rows 2022Q1 and 2022Q2 sum to the six-month figure 25,456 within 2 thousand, and the three 2022 quarters sum to the nine-month figure 41,462 within 2 thousand. Ownership gap: AstraZeneca's last Movantik row is 2019Q3 (gold series); RedHill began promoting Movantik in April 2020 and its own interim statements print Movantik revenues for the three months ended March 31, 2020 as a dash (Q1 2021 6-K 0001178913-21-001921, Note 6). No document of either issuer prints a Movantik figure for 2019Q4 or 2020Q1. Israel joined RedHill's rights in October 2020 (20-F for 2020, 0001558370-21-003168). End: RedHill's 6-K 0001178913-23-001555 states 'Revenues for Movantik were recorded up to and including February 1, 2023'; no 2023 quarter is printed: RedHill's H1 2023 6-K (0001558370-23-015048, exhibit rdhl-20230630xex99d2.htm, Note 6) prints Movantik revenues of (182) US$ thousands for the six months ended June 30, 2023 (net contra-revenue after the divestiture), and the 2023 20-F (0001558370-24-004806) recognizes contra-revenues of $2.6 million for Movantik in 2023; neither is a quarter, so the series ends at 2022Q4. The earlier description that RedHill printed Movantik only as annual figures was wrong: the NET REVENUES note of each interim statement carries the quarter.
search_log: Listed RedHill Biopharma (CIK 1553846) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (recent block) dated 2020-04-01 to 2023-06-30, form starting 6-K or 20-F including 6-K/A (256 filings); fetched every .htm document of each filing's index.json and searched the text for 'Movantik' followed by 'revenues'. The 'recent' block was the only block read; the older files block starts 2012-2013 and ends before 2020.
The earlier search read only the 2,599-character cover document of 0001558370-20-010480 and the press-release exhibits; the interim financial statements are exhibit 99.2 and carry the quarterly line.
Fourth quarters: no RedHill document prints a Movantik line for a three-month period ended December 31; derived from the 20-F full year and the Q3 nine-month column.

2019Q4 and 2020Q1: AstraZeneca's Q4 2019 and Q1 2020 releases carry no Movantik sales row (see the stop confirmation); RedHill's Q1 2021 6-K prints a dash for the three months ended March 31, 2020; RedHill held no rights before April 2020.

2023: RedHill 6-K 0001178913-23-001555 and 0001178913-23-002196 state revenues were recorded up to and including February 1, 2023 and that Movantik is no longer a RedHill product; the successor, Movantik Acquisition Co., an affiliate of HCR, is private. No 2023 quarter is printed.

Verifier addition: the original scan stopped at 2023-06-30. The H1 2023 6-K (0001558370-23-015048) and FY2023 20-F (0001558370-24-004806) were read afterwards: H1 2023 Movantik revenues (182) thousand for six months (no quarter split), FY2023 contra-revenues $2.6 million; no 2023 quarter can be derived as a positive Movantik line.
